checks.context: Exact merged release base, matching dual database routing, two workers, authenticated original Chromium, synthetic data. No on-site acceptance.
Exact release-bound workbench role, work identity, pagination and original fabric/craft facts consumers.

rules.rule: Only original live authorized follow-up roles and owned actions are included, with no scope from unrelated roles.
rules.initialization: Current original stored and virtual task facts initialize independent of new fields.
rules.dateAndPermission: Same server permissions and route/acquisition scope; a page search alone does not give visibility.
rules.expectation: Authorized before pagination, recipient and status exact; original order ID and live visible factory are searchable without exposing another identity. An unrelated merchandiser sees empty results and the original record returns 404.

rules.rule: Existing original handover, exact step communication and job conditions remain the writers.
rules.initialization: Use current task, original adopted preparation, registered order and original pending/report records.
rules.dateAndPermission: Original live assignment and clock; no cut-piece movement, unrelated permission, or new SLA.
rules.expectation: Real signed craft actor records one original note across lost receipt and replay; ordinary merchandiser cannot write. Preorder uses the same original materials and stays untimed.

rules.rule: Keep both original signed return entrypoints and the exact current document or version.
rules.initialization: Reads existing case/contract version and the original attach authorization.
rules.dateAndPermission: Old role and special narrow permissions remain on the original service. Retrying the same response uses the same actual body and key.
rules.expectation: Signed ordinary actor recovers a lost response with the same exact key and document. Two stale signed tabs get the real quota rejection before a smaller replacement saves. Original first signed time and slot count are unchanged. Craft and process catalogs remain independent on the same original transport.

rules.rule: Use the real role navigation and existing original order and document paths, with consistent retry and return context.
rules.initialization: Existing original menus and warm/cold route behaviors remain. No third shell or startup feature gate.
rules.dateAndPermission: Existing original domain reads revalidate access and exact version; closing a current action does not silently discard unacknowledged changes.
rules.expectation: Real signed role menu, existing order document directory GET, exact budget/instruction GET and return to the same order, exact original row/focus and retained IE archive route. Confirm cold browser resources where selected.

rules.rule: Choose the complete original authorized candidate set using lightweight facts without hydrating native todos; original detail and notification clocks remain in their existing domain.
rules.initialization: Original pending task and handover readiness, actual adopted original plan and saved preorder document are authoritative on one read-only snapshot.
rules.dateAndPermission: Remember selected Acceptance scene and exact current handover role. No original plan writes or clock reset. A preorder remains untimed and unowned drafts do not become searchable.
rules.expectation: One, fifteen and fifty native tasks require zero per-task hydrated clock reads and bounded physical SQL. Original ready preorder returns its saved customer and PO only to the active recipient. Formal conversion preserves exact adopted due times for old and new paths.
